params.body:
## What

- `Capability::WORKBENCH_KINDS` gains `preview.push` and `forge.deploy` (control v0.26.0): a session puts a pull request on a project's preview site through the gateway, which holds the site's Forge deploy trigger as `forge-deploy-<slug>`; nothing on the session's machine can deploy.
- The workbench capability names `forge:<slug>` beside `portal:<slug>` for every project, from one constant (`FORGE_RESOURCE`), like `PORTAL_RESOURCE`. Playbook capabilities are unchanged.
- `WorkbenchAdmission::repos()` leaves `forge:` out as it leaves `portal:` out, so the stale-admission check keeps comparing repositories only.

The gateway requires kind and resource in both the grant (elixir, companion PR) and this capability; `hand.mjs admit` on the Mac names the same list on the YubiKey.

## Tests

`php artisan test --filter="Capability|Admission|Workbench|FourTokens"`: 31 passed (`IngestCapabilityTest` and `CapabilityKmsTest` updated for the kinds and the `forge:` resource). Full suite in a fresh worktree: 577 of 578; the one failure is `BuildStampTest`, which reads the checkout's `.git` and meets a worktree's `.git` file (environment).

## Order

Independent of the others in effect: a capability naming a kind the gateway does not yet know is simply not used for it. Companion PRs: control (the kinds), elixir (the grant), platform (docs), `hand.mjs preview` on the Mac.
params.title: The workbench capability names the preview kinds and forge:<slug>
